name: Optic Nerve Disorders
hyTerms: Pain on movement with colour loss
MRI brain with orbits and venography

reference.source: Parsons' Diseases of the Eye 23rd Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Swollen both discs: measure intracranial pressure
Pain on movement with colour loss: neuritis
Scalp pain with pallor: steroids before biopsy
reference.pathophysiology: Axoplasmic stasis swells discs in intracranial hypertension while demyelination slows conduction (prolonged VEP) and ischaemia infarcts laminar segments altitudinally; arteritic granulomas occlude posterior ciliaries chalking the nerve head.
additionalDifferentials: Papilloedema versus papillitis by bilaterality and pain
Arteritic versus nonarteritic by systemic symptoms and markers
Compressive versus glaucomatous by field meridian and pallor
additionalInvestigations: MRI brain with orbits and venography
ESR, CRP with temporal biopsy in suspected arteritis
Lumbar puncture opening pressure after imaging
